Package com.egradx.notification.spi

Record Class EgradxDeliveryRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.egradx.notification.spi.EgradxDeliveryRequest
Record Components:
deliveryId - stable across retries of the same delivery — a channel whose provider accepts an idempotency key should pass this, since delivery is at-least-once (see EgradxNotificationChannel)
messageId - the message this delivery belongs to
organizationId - the tenant it is sent on behalf of, whose channel configuration applies; null for platform-level
channel - the channel being asked to deliver it
notificationKey - the application's name for this kind of message; may be null
address - where to deliver it, in the channel's address format
content - what to deliver
attempt - 1 on the first attempt, 2 on the first retry, and so on
replyTo - the sender's requested reply address; null for the configured default
attachments - files to attach; each loads its content only when asked
model - the template model the content was rendered from, as plain data; null for ready-made content. For channels that send structured messages instead of text — WhatsApp's approved templates take their parameters from it
locale - the language the content was rendered in; null for the default
public record EgradxDeliveryRequest(UUID deliveryId, UUID messageId, UUID organizationId, EgradxChannel channel, String notificationKey, String address, EgradxMessageContent content, int attempt, String replyTo, List<EgradxAttachment> attachments, Map<String,Object> model, Locale locale) extends Record
One delivery attempt, as handed to a channel.
